rules.cwe_name: Use of Potentially Dangerous Function
rules.description: DOM functions that act like 'eval' and execute strings as code are dangerous and impede program analysis and understanding. Consequently, they should not be used.

rules.cwe_name: Off-by-one Error
rules.description: An array index is compared to be less than or equal to the 'length' property, and then used in an indexing operation that could be out of bounds.

rules.cwe_name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
rules.description: External links that open in a new tab or window but do not specify link type 'noopener' or 'noreferrer' are a potential security risk.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS)
rules.description: Matching HTML tags using regular expressions is hard to do right, and can easily lead to security issues.

rules.cwe_name: Weak Password Recovery Mechanism for Forgotten Password
rules.description: Using the HTTP Host header to construct a link in an email can facilitate phishing attacks and leak password reset tokens.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
rules.description: When escaping special characters using a meta-character like backslash or ampersand, the meta-character has to be escaped first to avoid double-escaping, and conversely it has to be unescaped last to avoid double-unescaping.

rules.cwe_name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
rules.description: Downloading executables and other sensitive files over an insecure connection opens up for potential man-in-the-middle attacks.

rules.cwe_name: Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Information
rules.description: Using unencrypted protocols to fetch dependencies can leave an application open to man-in-the-middle attacks.

rules.cwe_name: Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition
rules.description: Separately checking the state of a file before operating on it may allow an attacker to modify the file between the two operations.

rules.cwe_name: Incomplete List of Disallowed Inputs
rules.description: Checking for the "javascript:" URL scheme without also checking for "vbscript:" and "data:" suggests a logic error or even a security vulnerability.
